name.en: Ritmo Sand Linen Tailored Shorts with a Mid Rise, Front Pleats and a Clean Mid-Thigh Hem

description.en: Tailored linen shorts with a mid rise and soft front pleats. The hem sits at mid-thigh and holds a crease through the day.
